# Prestige Bannerghatta Road: Full Information

> Prestige Bannerghatta Road is an upcoming community of residential plots and independent villas by Prestige Group on about 104 acres off Bannerghatta Road, near Bilvaradhahalli, South Bengaluru. Bannerghatta Biological Park is about 7 km away, IIM Bangalore and Apollo Hospitals about 11 km and Electronic City about 18 km. Plot sizes, villa configurations and prices will be announced at launch; the amenities are planned around a clubhouse, pools, a gym, courts, cricket practice, walking and cycling paths and gardens.

## Planned Amenities

Prestige Bannerghatta Road is being planned around a clubhouse with a multipurpose hall, a residents’ lounge and indoor games, a swimming pool and a children’s pool, a gym with yoga and meditation spaces, courts for tennis, badminton and basketball, cricket practice, walking, jogging and cycling paths, central greens and themed gardens, play areas, a senior citizens’ garden and a pet park. The final list will be shared at launch.

## Questions buyers ask

### What is Prestige Bannerghatta Road?

An upcoming community of residential plots and independent villas by Prestige Group on about 104 acres off Bannerghatta Road in South Bengaluru. Register now to receive the plot sizes, villa plans and prices first, with priority access at launch.

### Where is Prestige Bannerghatta Road located?

Off Bannerghatta Road in South Bengaluru, near Bilvaradhahalli. Bannerghatta Biological Park is about 7 km away, Royal Meenakshi Mall about 8 km, Apollo Hospitals and IIM Bangalore about 11 km and Electronic City Phase 1 about 18 km.

### What can I buy at Prestige Bannerghatta Road?

Residential plots, on which to build a home of your own, and independent villas. Plot sizes, villa configurations and areas will be announced at launch.

### What is the price of Prestige Bannerghatta Road?

Prices will be announced at launch. Register your interest to receive the price list first, with priority access at launch.

### How large is the project?

About 104 acres, planned as a low-rise neighbourhood of plots and villas. The master plan will be shared at launch.

### What amenities are planned?

The community is being planned around a clubhouse, a swimming pool and a children’s pool, a gym with yoga and meditation spaces, courts for tennis, badminton and basketball, cricket practice, walking, jogging and cycling paths, gardens, play areas, a senior citizens’ garden and a pet park. The final list will be shared at launch.

### Who is the developer?

Prestige Group, founded in 1986, with 316 projects completed across more than 212 million sq ft as of 31 March 2026. Its South Bengaluru homes include Prestige Falcon City on Kanakapura Road and Prestige Song of the South on Begur Main Road.

### Is Prestige Bannerghatta Road a plotted layout or a villa project?

It is both. The community combines residential plots, sold as land for you to build on, with independent villas that Prestige designs and builds. Both share one planned neighbourhood of about 104 acres near Bilvaradhahalli, with the same clubhouse, pools, courts and gardens, and there are no apartment towers in the plan. How the land is divided between plots and villas will show on the master plan at launch.

### What stage is the project at, and when does it launch?

Prestige Bannerghatta Road is upcoming, and the details on this website are as of 21 October 2026. The plot sizes, villa configurations, prices, payment plans and master plan have not been released and will be announced at launch. A launch date will be shared with registered buyers as soon as it is announced, and registering gives you priority access when the project opens.

### When will plots and villas be handed over?

The handover timelines for plots and for villas will be confirmed at launch. They may not be the same: a plot can be handed over once the layout’s roads and services are ready for you to start building, while a villa is handed over when the house itself is finished. Ask for the date that applies to your exact plot or villa, and check that the agreement states it before you pay.

### Are the pictures on this website photographs of the project?

No. Every picture here is an artistic impression of Prestige Bannerghatta Road, for representation only. They convey the mood Prestige is aiming for, with verandas, courtyards, tree-lined streets and a pond-side pavilion, but they are neither site photographs nor plans. Judge sizes and layouts from the villa plans and the master plan released at launch.

### Have the plot sizes been announced?

Not yet. The plot sizes will be announced at launch, along with how many plots there are of each size and where they sit on the master plan. When the list is out, look beyond the area: a corner position, the width of the road in front and what lies next door can make two plots of the same size at Prestige Bannerghatta Road feel quite different. Register your interest to receive the full list first.

### Which villa configurations will be offered?

The villa configurations, with the number of bedrooms and the areas of each type, will be announced at launch; no bedroom count has been published yet. When the plans arrive, read each villa type for both its plot area and its built area, and see how the rooms, the living spaces and the parking are arranged. The artistic impressions suggest the character Prestige intends for the villas, not their layouts.

### How does buying a plot at Prestige Bannerghatta Road work?

You buy the land and build the house yourself, choosing the architect, the design and the timing, inside a community planned with a clubhouse, gardens, courts and paths. Before you commit, ask whether the layout sets design rules for homes, such as height limits or a common look for the front, whether building must start by a set date, and when the plot is handed over so that construction can begin.

### What does buying an independent villa include?

Here a villa means a complete home: Prestige draws up the design, builds the house on a plot of its own and hands both over to you together, for one price. The configurations, plot areas and built areas of each villa type come at launch, so ask for the plan and the cost sheet of the exact villa you like before you decide.

### Should I choose a plot or a villa?

Choose a plot if you want to design the house yourself, or to build later or in stages as your budget allows, and you are ready to manage construction. Choose a villa if you would rather have a finished home, one price and one handover. Plot owners and villa owners at Prestige Bannerghatta Road share the same planned clubhouse, pools, courts and gardens, so the decision rests on your budget, your time and how involved you want to be.

### What is the difference between plot area, carpet area and super built-up area?

Plot area measures land: everything inside the plot’s boundary. A villa adds a house, and houses are measured three ways: carpet area is the floor you can furnish, built-up area also counts the walls, and super built-up area loads on a portion of shared spaces too. When the Prestige Bannerghatta Road plans and price list come out, check which area each figure uses, and in which unit, so that you compare like with like.

### Why is there no price on this website yet?

Because Prestige Bannerghatta Road has not launched. Prestige has not put a figure on the plots or the villas, and this website does not guess one. Prices, sizes, villa types and payment terms are due to be released together at launch. Register your interest and the price sheet will be sent to you as soon as it is out.

### What will the cost sheet show?

A cost sheet is the full price of one specific plot or villa. Expect it to give the plot number or villa type with its area and unit, the base rate and base price, any premium for position, any clubhouse, amenity or infrastructure charges, any maintenance deposit, and taxes. Stamp duty and registration are extra over the price. At Prestige Bannerghatta Road, request it for one named plot or villa rather than settling for a price band.

### What payment plans will be offered?

The payment plans come out alongside the price list at launch, and a plot and a villa may not share one schedule. Villa buyers commonly pay in steps that follow the building work, from foundation to handover. Plot buyers may see payments linked to progress on the layout’s roads and services, ending with the sale deed. Before choosing, count the instalments and note which event releases each one.

### Can I get a home loan for a plot or a villa?

Yes, but the loan type differs. For a villa, a standard home loan is the usual route, with the bank paying out as construction moves forward. For bare land, banks offer plot loans, and some offer a composite loan that funds the land now and the house later. Each lender sets its own terms. Get your eligibility checked before Prestige Bannerghatta Road launches so that a good plot or villa does not slip away while the paperwork catches up.

### What is an expression of interest, and do I have to pay for one?

An expression of interest records that you want a plot or villa before allotment opens, and some developers take a refundable deposit with it. Registering your interest through this website is different: it is free and it is not a booking. Should Prestige Bannerghatta Road invite expressions of interest against a deposit, confirm the payee, the refund terms and timing, and how the amount is credited towards the plot or villa you finally pick.

### What should I check before paying a token?

Know precisely which plot or villa the token is for, with its area and a cost sheet. Pay only into the developer’s account as named on the booking papers; this website never handles money. Find out whether you get the token back if you withdraw, how soon and minus what charges, and read the payment schedule and the handover date. At Prestige Bannerghatta Road most of these answers come at launch, so wait until you have them in writing.

### Which part of Bengaluru is Prestige Bannerghatta Road in?

South Bengaluru, off Bannerghatta Road, near Bilvaradhahalli. For post, it reads Off Bannerghatta Road, near Bilvaradhahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560083. The position of the gate will be confirmed with the master plan at launch. Because the land stretches over about 104 acres, your own home could sit a little nearer to or farther from any given place than the figures quoted here.

### How far is Electronic City from Prestige Bannerghatta Road?

Electronic City Phase 1 is about 18 km from Bilvaradhahalli by road. That is a road distance, not a travel time, and the time it takes depends on the route and the hour. If you work there, drive the route on a weekday morning and evening before you choose a plot or villa. IIM Bangalore, on Bannerghatta Road, is closer, at about 11 km.

### How far is the nearest hospital?

Of the hospitals listed on this website, Apollo Hospitals on Bannerghatta Road is the closest, at about 11 km by road from Bilvaradhahalli. Narayana Health City at Bommasandra is about 21 km away. If you have elderly parents or young children, time the drive to both at night as well as by day, and note the clinics and pharmacies closest to the site when you visit.

### Are there schools near Prestige Bannerghatta Road?

The school listed on this website is Treamis World School at Hulimangala, roughly 14 km away by road. Parents should try the drive at real school times, ask schools whether their buses come out towards Bilvaradhahalli, and look for schools nearer the site during a visit. At launch, find out where the community’s gate will sit, because it decides the first stretch of every school run.

### What is there to do nearby at weekends?

Bannerghatta Biological Park is about 7 km away by road, the closest of the places measured on this website, which makes it an easy outing with children. For shopping, the listed mall is Royal Meenakshi Mall at Hulimavu, about 8 km away. Within Prestige Bannerghatta Road, the planned central greens, themed gardens and walking, jogging and cycling paths are meant for everyday time outdoors.

### What will the clubhouse have?

The clubhouse at Prestige Bannerghatta Road is planned with a residents’ lounge, a multipurpose hall and indoor games. Its size, its opening date and its position on the master plan will be confirmed at launch. Plot buyers who plan to build later should check from when they get clubhouse access, and how any clubhouse charge on the cost sheet is calculated.

### What is planned for sport and fitness?

Courts for tennis, badminton and basketball, multipurpose courts and cricket practice are planned, along with a gym with yoga and meditation spaces, a swimming pool and a children’s pool. Lighting for evening play, court bookings and any coaching are still to be announced. If sport matters to your family, ask about these at launch and see where the courts sit on the master plan.

### Does the plan cater to children, grandparents and pets?

Yes. Children have play and toddler areas, a children’s pool and cricket practice; older residents have a senior citizens’ garden and paths for walking; and a pet park is planned for dogs and their owners. Ask at launch where the play areas sit relative to the main internal roads, and how far the senior citizens’ garden is from the plots and villas you are considering at Prestige Bannerghatta Road.

### What is everyday life like in a low-rise community?

With plots and villas instead of towers, Prestige Bannerghatta Road is planned around streets, gardens and paths. Each home stands on its own land, so neighbours live beside you rather than above or below, and the streets and gardens shape daily life as much as the home itself. Shared space is spread across about 104 acres, so check on the master plan how far your home is from the clubhouse and the greens you would use most.

### Who will run the amenities, and what will maintenance cost?

Maintenance charges, and who runs the amenities after handover, will be confirmed at launch. Ask how the monthly maintenance is worked out, whether it differs for plots and villas, when it starts on a plot you have not yet built on, and whether a maintenance deposit or advance appears on the cost sheet. At Prestige Bannerghatta Road, get these answers in writing with your cost sheet.

### Which company is behind the Prestige brand?

Prestige Estates Projects Limited. The business started in Bengaluru in 1986, first as a partnership firm and then as a company. Since October 2010 its shares have traded on the National Stock Exchange of India, as PRESTIGE, and on BSE, as 533274. The registered office is Prestige Falcon Towers, No. 19, Brunton Road, Bengaluru 560025, so the company behind Prestige Bannerghatta Road is a Bengaluru firm.

### How many projects has Prestige completed, and how many are under way?

As of 31 March 2026, Prestige had completed 316 projects across more than 212 million sq ft, counting all its businesses, and had 47 residential projects under way. These figures describe the company as a whole. They do not set the timeline for Prestige Bannerghatta Road itself, whose sizes, prices and handover dates are announced at launch.

### Which Prestige villa communities can I look at for reference?

Three Bengaluru examples: Prestige Golfshire at Nandi Hills, a finished community of 4 BHK villas; Prestige White Meadows, a villa project at Whitefield; and Prestige Lakeside Habitat on Sarjapur Road, which mixes apartments with villas. A walk through Golfshire, which is complete, shows the streets, gardens and finishes Prestige has built for villa owners: a useful check while the villa plans for Prestige Bannerghatta Road are still awaited.

### Does Prestige have other homes in South Bengaluru?

Yes. In the south of the city, Prestige has Prestige Falcon City on Kanakapura Road, Prestige Song of the South on Begur Main Road and Prestige Sunrise Park in Electronic City. They are apartment projects, while Prestige Bannerghatta Road offers plots and villas, so they tell you more about the developer than about the kind of home you would buy here.

### Where else does Prestige build homes?

Prestige’s ongoing or upcoming residential projects are in Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Mumbai, NCR, Goa, Kochi, Kozhikode, Mangaluru, Mysore, Ooty and Sakleshpur. Bengaluru is its home city: the company was founded there in 1986, and its registered office is on Brunton Road. Its housing ranges from high-rise apartments and integrated townships to a golf course community and plotted enclaves; Prestige Bannerghatta Road pairs plots with villas.

No. This website is operated by a channel partner. It is not the official website of Prestige Group. We do not take bookings or collect payments; any payment should go only to the developer, against written booking documents.

Yes. Ask for one through the form, and we will phone to agree a day and time. Because the plans are not out yet, a visit before launch is mainly about the land, the roads in and the area around Bilvaradhahalli. Come by the route you would use every day, and ask when the master plan will be shared and which part of the land is likely to open first.

### What happens after I register my interest?

We note whether you want a plot or a villa, and the size you have in mind, and call you back. As Prestige releases them, we send you the brochure, or the latest project details if the brochure is not out yet, with the plot sizes, villa plans and price sheet for Prestige Bannerghatta Road, and you get priority access at launch. Registering is free and is not a booking.

### How will plots and villas be allotted at launch?

The allotment process for Prestige Bannerghatta Road will be announced at launch, together with which plots and villas are released first. Buyers who have registered their interest hear about the release first and get priority access. Before allotment opens, shortlist two or three options on the master plan, with a cost sheet for each, so that you can decide quickly if your first choice goes.
